title: Towards Understanding and Quantifying Uncertainty for Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models to generate individuals of specific genders across 13 distinct job roles, and using a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) to verify via yes/no questions if the generated images accurately reflect the specified gender concepts.

Prompting text-to-image models to generate individuals of specific races (White, Black, and Asian) across 13 distinct job roles, and using a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) to verify via yes/no questions if the generated images accurately reflect the specified racial concepts.
